purpose: Prompts for six new concept images: trail motorcycles and quad bikes ridden by the Rad-e Hoor cast. NOT generated yet; the image tool must be run by the author. Same visual language as the existing PNGs in this folder.
style_prefix: Concept image for Rad-e Hoor (The Solar Trace), a fictional canyon in Iran's Lut Desert. Visual language: stylized 3D volume with selective ink contours, restrained surface-attached hatching and subtle print texture; material color readable, anatomy functional, grounded adult proportions. Warm ochre/rust canyon palette, hard dusk or dawn light. Contemporary everyday Iranian riding clothes: sun-faded jackets, dust, worn gloves, goggles, scarves wound around head and face (shemagh / dastar). No logos, brand names, invented text, weapons pointed at the viewer, skulls or magical markings. Do not imitate any existing fictional character or recognizable real person. Faces covered by the scarf must not signal good or evil.

images.subject: Daniyal (38, strong forearms, squared jaw) on a dual-sport trail motorcycle, 3/4 front view, rolling slowly into a narrow sandstone slot canyon; scarf over nose and mouth, goggles pushed up; dust trail behind. Mood: cautious, listening, engine at idle.

Mina (32, water-hole keeper) on a small quiet electric trail bike, standing on the pegs on a ridge, scarf wrapped around head leaving only eyes, a trap-camera pouch and a water bottle strapped to the frame. Mood: silent scouting, dawn light, no exhaust or dust cloud.

Roya (mercenary hauler) on a worn four-wheel quad bike hauling jerricans and a coiled rope on a rear rack, crossing salt-crusted ground at a canyon mouth; face fully wrapped in a faded cloth, goggles. Mood: heavy, practical, loud.

Arash (19) driving a quad with Sara (35) riding behind holding a field notebook against her chest, both scarved, in a lightless pre-dawn canyon with only a thin strip of sky; a camel (Dara) far behind in the gloom. Mood: tense, whispering speed.

A masked courier on a dusty quad at the edge of the artificial-noon floodlights; face and head fully wrapped, an armband with the number 9 on the sleeve, shadow cast short and sharp by white lamps. Mood: anonymous, threatening, nobody could name him.

Wide dawn shot: two trail motorcycles and one quad parked in a line on the plain below the canyon, riders standing with scarves pulled down for the first time, faces visible and weary, a camel and small camp tents behind. Mood: relief, names being said.
